PREREGISTRATION.brief: Murat, 2026-09-20: a gut feeling, tested against good and bad made-up scenarios built from our own data
PREREGISTRATION.primary: the twin MOVEMENT lift over the control twin, block-paired with a Newey-West lag-2 t
PREREGISTRATION.secondary: sign accuracy, Brier, calibration by confidence decile, and the net long-short against the shuffled control

question: Does a committed decision MOVE the right way when one favourable or one adverse development is appended to an otherwise byte-identical fictional scenario -- and does it move more than it does on an unrelated appended sentence?

cost_model.charged_on: realised turnover sum|dw| per monthly rebalance

adoption_line: adoption: NOT_ADOPTED — reliability_weight 0 until N>=300 over >=12 independent month blocks and a forward record exists

construction.convention: enter at the first open of M+1, exit at the first open of M+2, minus SPY over the same two opens

masking.note: a document with no masked token is one where neither the ticker nor an issuer-name token appeared in its text -- common for a headline that never names the company -- but a HIGH rate of them would be a mask leak

typed_events.note: a cell with no typed row is keyed `no_event` and takes the generic development pair; the coverage above is what separates 'twins keyed by the dominant event' from 'most twins were generic'

fiction.numbers: kept verbatim; a bare four-digit year is not shifted

PRIMARY_block_level.basis: the run's OWN monthly long-short series

MDE.which_decides: the BLOCK figure. N decisions drawn from ~19 month blocks collapse to an effective n near the block count for anything that shares a month's market move (canon section 58); the per-decision line is reported and never deciding

good_twin_lift_vs_control.label: good twin raises, minus an UNRELATED favourable development
good_twin_lift_vs_control.note: the twin's strict movement rate minus the CONTROL twin's, block by block; a difference over the same month blocks, not two levels subtracted

bad_twin_lift_vs_control.label: bad twin lowers, minus an UNRELATED adverse development
bad_twin_lift_vs_control.note: the twin's strict movement rate minus the CONTROL twin's, block by block; a difference over the same month blocks, not two levels subtracted

PRIMARY_twin_movement.reading: the pass rate on its own is not the finding: a model that answers the same thing every time passes the spec's `delta >= 0` condition at 100%, which is why unmoved_rate and the strict rates are printed and the LIFT over the SIGN-MATCHED control twin is the primary. Each lift differences a twin against an unrelated development of the same sign, so what it isolates is relevance, not valence -- the first smoke run's single favourable control made the bad twin look strong for the wrong reason

real_minus_shuffled_control.label: real decisions minus the shuffled-digest control

cost_cancellation.reading: the two books rebalance identically on the same dates, so the cost line cancels in the DIFFERENCE to the extent the turnovers match; the levels are NOT cost-robust and are reported gross beside net

secondary_returns.caution: X_anon_gap's 09-19 run found BOTH of its arms lose money net on this panel (raw -18.89%/yr, masked -16.87%/yr). This block is reported, never deciding: the gym is graded on MOVEMENT and may never become a trading arm

adoption.entered_as: candidate field only: gut_signal {direction, confidence, reliability_weight}
adoption.never: veto or override; it can never flip a REFUSED to a BUY, never override a hard gate, and never act alone
adoption.why_not: N 128 < 300; no forward record exists for this gym yet
adoption.line: adoption: NOT_ADOPTED — reliability_weight 0 until N>=300 over >=12 independent month blocks and a forward record exists

P1_temporal_integrity.time_locked_control_model: ChronoGPT is not distributed as GGUF and needs a transformers path this job does not have (spec_lane_x section 1.6); the date SHIFT is a fiction device here, not a time-locked model
P1_temporal_integrity.cutoff_source: community cutoff trackers + provider pages for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct; NOT an official Alibaba cutoff page (spec_lane_x section 1.3)

P2_dynamic_universe.note: the forward label requires the SUCCESSOR month to be literally the next one, so a delisted or halted name contributes no two-month return labelled as one (night_r2_monthly_llm.widened_forward_excess)

P3_direction_flip.test: the twin test IS this job's direction-flip test: one appended development of known sign, and the rate at which the committed decision's direction flips with it

field_provenance.direction, size_pct, expected_return_20d: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-Q4_K_M via this job's frozen SYSTEM+PROMPT (sha256 on the receipt), temperature 0
field_provenance.good_twin / bad_twin / control_good_twin: DETERMINISTIC: night_scenario_gym.DEVELOPMENT_FAMILIES keyed by the cell's dominant typed event, hashed as counterfactual_library_hash. No model wrote a twin
field_provenance.masking: night_r2_monthly_llm.widened_digests, i.e. r7_news_representation.mask_company over tokenise -- the same function night_x_anonymisation_gap masks with

field_provenance.fwd: deterministic: SPY-excess open-to-open month return from bars.parquet

LAP.reason_if_not_applicable: PANEL-B is entirely AFTER Qwen2.5-7B's ~2024-06 cutoff, so every case here is already the post-cutoff arm; the date shift makes the case unlookuppable, it does not make the model older

anonymisation_gap.reason: not measured by this job: every arm reads the MASKED text, so there is no raw arm to difference. X_anon_gap measures the gap on these cells
